testsuite.name: UC23 Exercise Diary
testsuite.details: Test suite automatically generated from CLARET specifications (UFCG)

testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: The iTrust2 user has authenticated themselves in iTrust2 (UC2) as a patient or HCP.

step.actions: patient: Any patient may select to either view their exercise diary , add a new exercise diary entry , or edit an existing entry . Any HCP may view exercise diary entries (but may not create them) for a patient in the iTrust2 system. The HCP may search for patients, and upon selecting one, will see a exercise diary displayed exactly as the patient would . All events are logged.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction
